_comment: Pre-result freeze record. Everything here was fixed before any real-weight inference was analysed. Verify against PREREGISTRATION.md, which is byte-identical to its state in the freeze commit.
freeze_commit_subject: Phase 1-2: frozen pre-registration and leakage-free harness

dataset.note: Clips are regenerated deterministically from the seed; no data files are shipped.

evaluation.primary_threshold_rule: 99th percentile of control-calibration scores pooled over evaluation frames (per-frame false-alarm rate = 1%)
evaluation.secondary_threshold_rule: clip-level false-alarm rate = 5% on control-calibration clips
evaluation.secondary_metric: restricted mean detection latency (RMDL), area under the Kaplan-Meier curve
evaluation.primary_test: paired Wilcoxon signed-rank, one-sided, Holm-corrected across 6 comparisons
evaluation.gate: median gain >= 1 frame against BOTH baselines AND Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.01

environment_at_freeze.note: The Modal image pins transformers==4.57.3 and installs a CUDA torch build; the adapter requires VJEPA2Model to expose its predictor and accept context_mask/target_mask.

results_status.reason: GPU credit unavailable; not a code blocker
results_status.exploratory_pilot: 128px CPU pilot, incomplete, no outcome numbers computed
